bundle.shortDescription: Single player for the first-era game, on your own game folder
bundle.longDescription: Leyline Solo runs a small world of your own on this PC for the first-era game: you, your companions and friends you invite. It uses your own game folder and reads its maps from it once; it never downloads, offers or shares the game. Open source; not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment.
